title: React Native Developer Intern
description:
**React Native Developer Intern – NeuraMach.AI**

**Function:** Engineering → Mobile App Development  
**Location:** Onsite – Pune  
**Duration:** 3–6 months  
**Start Date:** Immediate  
**Commitment:** Full-time Internship (possibility of full-time role)  
**Positions Available:** 1

**About NeuraMach.AI**

**NeuraMach.AI is an AI-native engineering studio turning frontier intelligence into production-grade systems.**

​We don’t wrap basic APIs. We build custom, autonomous **Agentic AI platforms from the ground up**, architecting cloud-heavy, high-throughput systems on AWS designed for mission-critical scale. Our engineering operates at the edge of machine intelligence—fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), engineering Large Foundation Models (LFMs), and deploying autonomous multi-agent systems that solve complex, multi-step business logic.

​From deploying high-impact adaptive platforms that reach thousands of users to solving high-stakes enterprise workflows, we bridge the gap between speculative AI research and deterministic business value. Led by technologists from premier institutions, NeuraMach.AI is where obsessive engineers come to build what’s next—and where forward-thinking enterprises come to make AI their unfair competitive advantage.

**Role Description**  
As a React Native Developer Intern, you will design and develop performant, accessible mobile interfaces for our AI-powered learning products across iOS and Android. You’ll work closely with product, design, and backend teams to build and ship scalable, high-quality mobile experiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build responsive, high-performance mobile UIs using React Native, with a strong focus on accessibility and user experience.
* Contribute to mobile app architecture alongside Tech Leads.
* Integrate backend APIs and manage complex state and user interactions across the app.
* Handle native module integration and platform-specific behavior for iOS and Android.
* Participate in automated testing (unit, integration, E2E) and CI workflows.
* Suggest improvements in technologies, libraries, and code quality.
* Work in an agile setup with UX/UI, backend, and product teams.
* Participate in NeuraMach.AI’s mobile engineering initiatives: code reviews, tech discussions, and knowledge sharing.

Our stack includes React Native, with backend in Node.js and FastAPI. Knowledge of React.js/Next.js is a plus for cross-platform/web-adjacent work.

**Experience and Required Skills**

***Professional Experience***

* Minimum 1 year experience with React Native on production-level or published mobile applications.
* Proven work on React Native projects, ideally with apps published on Play Store/App Store.
* Experience working in agile, multidisciplinary teams.

***Technical Skills***

* Strong expertise in React Native and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Navigation, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API).
* Solid understanding of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript.
* Experience with native module integration and platform-specific configurations (iOS/Android).
* Good practices in state management, side effects, and component lifecycle.
* Experience with Jest, React Native Testing Library, or Detox.
* Basic knowledge of accessibility (a11y) and mobile UX principles.
* Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (Fastlane, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, EAS Build).
* Bonus: Knowledge of React.js/Next.js, native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin) development.

***Soft Skills***

* Self-driven, detail-oriented, and reliable.
* Strong communicator and team player in cross-functional environments.
* Passion for high-quality, user-centered mobile interfaces.

**How to Apply**  
Send your resume and portfolio (PDF, GitHub, or Play Store/App Store links) to: **HR@NeuraMach.AI and Dimpal@NeuraMach.AI**   
Subject: *Application – React Native Developer Intern – [Your Name]*

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Software Engineer - Frontend Developer**

**Job Location:** Commerzone IT Tech Park, Yerwada - Pune.

**Position Description**

The Client Engineer works on the frontlines of a game development team to create compelling game experiences for our SG products. You will implement, debug, modify and generally support in-game features, development, and operational tools in a timely manner and actively participate in the design of the games.

You will need to have technical skills to operate independently, and the communication and collaboration skills to be an integral and valued team player. At the Software Engineer level, you will need to have the solid skills, experience, and work ethic to succeed as a software engineer, and the desire to learn from your teammates, all while building games that delight our customers.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**  

* Implement and maintain client-side code for desktop and mobile games in a thorough and timely manner.
* Work on client/server-based applications using a variety of technologies including Typescript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS etc.

* Identify new tools/improved processes to aid the Development team in delivering new Gaming products.

* Contribute to the development of new/innovative games and different features in a game.

**Position Requirements**  
  
**Education:**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience

* 3-5 years of software development experience

* Strong understanding of JavaScript, its quirks, and workarounds

* Experience in Data structures (JavaScript or any programming language)

* Basic understanding of web mark-up, including HTML5 and CSS3
* Experience with development tools including IDEs, debuggers, bug tracking required

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git, CVS, SVN.
* Familiarity with Object Oriented Programming techniques and languages.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Knowledge of advanced JavaScript libraries and frameworks such as React JS,AngularJS, jQuery, NodeJS etc.

* Hands on experience on other programming languages such as Java, C++, Python etc

* Familiarity with front-end build tools, such as Grunt

* Distributed application (client/server) development experience

* Game Development experience.

* Experience in UI development and animations.

  

**Qualifications**

**Role Description:**

**Job Title: Senior Front End Developer**

**Overview:**

***Role Description :***

**About the Role**

  

As a Frontend Engineer specializing in React.js at Capco, you will be at the heart of designing and developing modern, high-performance, and accessible user interfaces for high-value digital solutions in the banking and insurance sectors. You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver robust, high-quality, and scalable applications.  
Your responsibilities will include:  
- Designing and developing responsive and performant user interfaces using React.js, while ensuring accessibility and user experience best practices.
  
- Collaborating on the definition of frontend architecture, alongside Tech Leads and other technical experts.
  
- Integrating backend APIs and handling complex state management and user interactions effectively.
  
- Participating in the implementation of automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and continuous integration pipelines.
  
- Contributing ideas on technology choices, frameworks, and libraries, and playing an active role in code quality improvement.
  
- Working in an agile environment, and collaborating effectively with UX/UI designers, Product Owners, and backend developers.
  
- Getting involved in the Capco frontend chapter through workshops, code reviews, tech watch, tech talks, and more.
  
At Capco, our stack includes Next.js 15 and therefore React.js 19. Our backend developers use Java / Spring Boot, and in some client contexts, we also offer NestJS—perfect for fullstack developers!  
We also welcome React Native developers when responsive web solutions no longer meet our clients' needs.  
EXPERIENCE AND REQUIRED SKILLS  
- Professional Experience
  
o Minimum of 5 years of experience in frontend development on complex projects or applications with high user exposure.  
o Proven track record working on React.js production projects, ideally in micro-frontend or modular application environments.  
o Experience working in agile teams, integrated within multidisciplinary setups  
- Technical skills
  
o Advanced expertise in Next.js / React.js and its ecosystem (Hooks, React Router, Redux/Zustand/Recoil, Context API, etc.).  
o Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3 (or modern styling tools like Styled Components, Tailwind CSS, etc.).  
o Good practices in state management, side effect handling, and component lifecycle management.  
o Experience with frontend automated testing tools such as Jest, React Testing Library, or Cypress.  
o Basic understanding of accessibility principles (a11y) and UX standards.  
o Familiarity with build tools and CI pipelines (e.g., Webpack, Vite, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).  
o Knowledge of additional frameworks (Next.js, Vue.js, Angular) is a valuable asset.  
- Soft Skills and Other Competencies
  
o Autonomous, detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and rigor.  
o Strong team player, able to communicate and collaborate effectively in cross-functional environments (UX/UI, backend, Product Owners, QA...).  
o Passion for building well-designed, high-performance interfaces, with a constant focus on the user experience.  
o Keen on knowledge sharing and contributing to continuous improvement.  
o Technologically curious, with a desire for ongoing growth and learning.  
o Fluent in English.

***If you are keen to join us, you will be part of an organization that values your contributions, recognizes your potential, and provides ample opportunities for growth. For more information, visit www.capco.com. Follow us on Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.***

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced UI Developer with strong front-end engineering expertise and a passion for building intuitive, data-driven user experiences. The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of modern JavaScript frameworks, responsive web development, data visualization technologies, and analytics platforms. In this role, you will design and develop highly interactive web applications, dashboards, and visualization solutions that convert complex datasets into meaningful business insights. You will collaborate closely with UX designers, product owners, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-performance, and user-centric digital experiences.

  

* **Role: Senior UI Developer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain responsive and scalable web applications using modern front-end technologies.
* Build reusable UI components and establish consistent design patterns across applications.
* Develop interactive dashboards, visual analytics solutions, and business intelligence interfaces.
* Create intuitive user experiences that simplify the interpretation of complex business and operational data.
* Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs, GraphQL services, and backend systems.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to understand data models and consumption requirements.
* Translate UI/UX designs, wireframes, and prototypes into production-ready applications.
* Implement responsive design principles and ensure cross-browser compatibility.
* Optimize application performance, accessibility, security, and maintainability.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
* Implement data visualization best practices and information design principles.
* Ensure compliance with accessibility standards such as WCAG.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and modern front-end development practices.
* Stay current with emerging front-end frameworks, visualization technologies, and industry trends.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8–12 years of experience in UI/Front-End development for enterprise applications.
* Strong expertise in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with modern frameworks such as React JS, Angular, or Vue JS.
* Experience developing reusable UI components and design systems.
* Strong knowledge of responsive web development and cross-browser compatibility.
* Experience with Bootstrap, Material UI, Tailwind CSS, or similar UI frameworks.
* Understanding of component-based architecture and state management concepts.
* Hands-on experience with visualization libraries including , Chart.js, Highcharts, Recharts, Plotly.
* Experience building executive dashboards, analytical reports, and KPI-driven interfaces.
* Ability to present complex datasets through intuitive visual experiences.
* Understanding of visualization best practices, data storytelling, and user-centered design.
* Experience working with analytics platforms and reporting solutions.
* Understanding of Data Structures, Conceptual Data Modeling, and RDBMS concepts.
* Proficiency in SQL for querying, analyzing, and validating data.
* Experience consuming and integrating data from multiple APIs and enterprise systems.
* Understanding of REST APIs, GraphQL, authentication, and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of Data Quality Management and Data Migration principles.
* Experience with browser performance optimization and debugging using DevTools.
* Strong understanding of application scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Experience working with Git and distributed version control systems.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of Agile Scrum development methodologies.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Familiarity with analytics and BI platforms such as, Power BI, Tableau, Looker
* Knowledge of cloud-native application architectures is desirable.
* Understanding of WCAG 2.0 accessibility standards.
* Experience implementing responsive layouts using Flexbox and CSS Grid.
* Focus on usability, accessibility, and customer-centric design principles.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with UX designers and product teams.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

title: Senior UI Engineer
description:
**About SailPoint & The Team**
------------------------------

SailPoint is the enterprise leader in identity security. Our engineering team delivers scalable, cloud-native SaaS products hosted on modern, event-driven microservice architectures in AWS.

  

We are seeking a versatile **UI Developer** who is enthusiastic about user experience and eager to solve real-world enterprise workflow challenges. In this role, you will be an integral part of an Agile engineering team, modernizing existing web interfaces, building responsive frontend features, and collaborating closely with UX designers and backend engineers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Frontend Architecture:** Design and build intuitive, maintainable, responsive web application UIs utilizing JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.
* **Component Modernization:** Evolve enterprise UI modules from legacy ExtJS structures to responsive AngularJS and modern frontend standards.
* **Full-Stack Collaboration:** Consume and make targeted enhancements to supporting backend REST APIs built on Java and Groovy.
* **Prototyping & UX:** Partner closely with UX consultants and product managers to rapidly prototype interaction designs and incorporate user feedback.
* **Telemetry & Quality:** Instrument and monitor frontend performance telemetry to pinpoint user friction points; develop automated test suites across modern desktop and mobile browsers.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** 6+ years of professional software development experience building cross-browser compatible, responsive web applications.
* **Core Web Stack:** Strong hands-on knowledge of JavaScript (ES5/ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, JSON, REST APIs, AJAX, and HTTP lifecycle.
* **Framework Experience:** Practical experience with JavaScript frameworks and build tools such as AngularJS, ExtJS, jQuery, Bootstrap, Grunt, or Bower.
* **Testing Automation:** Proven experience with automated UI testing frameworks (e.g., Karma, Jasmine, Protractor, Selenium).
* **Backend Fundamentals:** Working familiarity with Java or server-side scripting concepts to support full-stack collaboration.
* **Collaboration & Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills with an appetite for learning and working in an Agile/Scrum team.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Familiarity with Java web servers and application frameworks (Apache Tomcat, Spring, Grails, Groovy, servlets).
* Exposure to cloud deployments on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with mobile web viewports and responsive layouts (Cordova/PhoneGap, iOS/Android web views).
Familiarity with commercial enterprise security or identity management products.  

  

**What You Will Achieve (Year 1 Milestones)**
---------------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Ramp Up & Defect Resolution):** Master local development tooling (Grunt, Bower, npm), map legacy ExtJS and AngularJS dependencies, and resolve at least 5 initial frontend bug fixes across supported web browsers.
* **First 60 Days (Migrate Components & Prototype UX):** Convert initial legacy ExtJS views into clean AngularJS components, collaborate on interaction wireframes, and make targeted updates to supporting Java/Groovy backend REST APIs.
* **First 90 Days (Automated Testing & Telemetry):** Build automated cross-browser test suites (Karma, Jasmine, Protractor), achieving >80% test coverage on newly delivered UI components with zero visual regressions across mobile and desktop viewports.
* **Months 4–12 (Full Feature Ownership):** Independently take user stories from wireframe design to production-ready releases, delivering predictable sprint estimates and continuously improving application performance.

  

**About SailPoint India & Employee Benefits (Pune Location)**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* **Comprehensive Health & Wellness:** 100% company-paid medical insurance premiums covering employees and eligible dependents; includes accidental and term life coverage.
* **Preventive Care:** Annual company-sponsored health check-ups for employees and discounted diagnostic rates for family members.
* **Financial & Equity Rewards:** Competitive base salary, annual performance bonus, and eligibility for equity incentives.
* **Generous Paid Time Off:** 24 paid annual leaves plus 10 declared public holidays each year.
* **Workplace Flexibility:** Hybrid work model (2–3 days in-office per week) with flexible working hours for sustainable work-life balance.
* **Modern Workspace & Community:** Cutting-edge Pune office campus with ergonomic workstations, fully stocked pantry snacks, and regular team celebrations.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.
